metrics.justification: Duplicate notes consume top-k slots, skew RRF rank fusion, and degrade candidate diversity.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Causes redundant results in top-5 and displaces distinct relevant notes.

metrics.justification: Every note returned to an agent must trace its origin (author, session, source).
metrics.retrieval_impact: Unprovenanced notes allow unverified assertions to masquerade as ground truth.

metrics.justification: Graph-assisted retrieval requires minimum edge density to execute spreading activation.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Low edge density reduces multi-hop rescue rate from 60% to near 0%.

metrics.justification: Links pointing outside the verified boundary fail resolution and waste expansion budget.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Generates false graph expansions and increases multi-hop latency without recall gain.

metrics.justification: Notes with zero incoming or outgoing structural links cannot participate in multi-hop rescue.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Orphan notes rely 100% on direct lexical match and receive 0 graph assistance.

metrics.justification: Mass-generated template stubs inflate BM25 document frequencies and distort IDF scores.
metrics.retrieval_impact: High duplicate count degrades term discrimination across the lexical index.

metrics.justification: Notes in REVIEW cannot be served under security invariants I-001..I-012 until attested.
metrics.retrieval_impact: 633 notes are inaccessible to retrieval until human review is completed.

metrics.justification: Unverified notes must not leak into production context packs.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Protected boundary correctly drops these, but high ratio limits knowledge availability.
